info.title: Act public API
info.description:
Versioned API for Act customer automation, starting with the Terraform provider. Every call is authenticated with a service-account access token from the OAuth 2.0 client credentials grant; the tenant comes only from the token.

## Servers

Call the server of the region your tenant lives in:

- US (us1): `https://api.us1.act.security`
- EU (eu1): `https://api.eu1.act.security`

## Authentication

1. Create a service account in Act with read or write API access, and copy its client ID and client secret.
2. Exchange them for an access token at `https://auth.act.security/oidc/oauth2/token`. Set `resource` to the server URL of your region.
3. Send the token as `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. It expires after 15 minutes; request a new one when it does.

```sh
curl -X POST https://auth.act.security/oidc/oauth2/token \
  -d grant_type=client_credentials \
  -d client_id="$ACT_CLIENT_ID" \
  -d client_secret="$ACT_CLIENT_SECRET" \
  -d resource="$ACT_API_URL"
```

Do not request scopes. The token carries the service account ceiling (`act:read` or `act:write`) and the scopes its role grants. Each operation lists the scopes it requires.

serviceAccount.description: Service-account access token from the OAuth 2.0 client credentials grant. Send client_id and client_secret in the form body, with resource set to the API server URL.

scopes.act:read: Read access ceiling, set on the service account
scopes.act:write: Write access ceiling, set on the service account; every write needs it

DeploymentStatus.description: pending_consent: Azure only, waiting for an Entra admin to approve Act in the directory

deploymentId.description: Derived by Act from the tenant and the target; stable, unpredictable to others

existingDeployment.description: The live deployment already holding this target, if any; import it instead of creating a new one

roleArn.description: Known before the role exists in account mode; null for organizations

deploymentId.description: Derived by Act from the tenant and the target; stable, unpredictable to others

existingDeployment.description: The live deployment already holding this target, if any; import it instead of creating a new one

tenantConsented.description: Whether an Entra admin has approved Act for this tenant in this directory

adminConsentUrl.description: Stable link for an Entra admin; opening it starts consent, reading it does not

actServicePrincipalId.description: Act's service principal in the directory, once consented

bindingMarker.description: Put this text in the custom role description; verification checks it

deploymentId.description: Derived by Act from the tenant and the target; stable, unpredictable to others

existingDeployment.description: The live deployment already holding this target, if any; import it instead of creating a new one

actAwsAccountId.description: AWS account of the Act federation role the customer pool trusts

sessionBinding.description: Role session name Act uses for this deployment; the pool admits only it

attributeCondition.description: Ready-made CEL condition for the workload identity pool provider

consentUrl.description: Set while the deployment is pending_consent

AwsDeploymentCreate.description: An AWS account or organization to connect. The deployment id comes from GET /v1/onboarding/aws. Act verifies the role before it stores anything.

AwsDeploymentPatch.description: Merge patch. A member left out keeps its value; null clears it. Role and target changes re-verify.

AzureDeploymentCreate.description: An Azure subscription or management group to connect through Act's app. Before consent the deployment is created as pending_consent.

AzureDeploymentPatch.description: Merge patch. A member left out keeps its value. Identity changes re-verify.

GcpDeploymentCreate.description: A GCP project or organization to connect. Act derives the service account and workload identity provider from the deployment id; it never takes them from the request.

GcpDeploymentPatch.description: Merge patch. A member left out keeps its value.

cleanupRequired.description: Cloud-side resources that still trust Act; remove them

IntegrationCreate.description: An integration to install. Each type takes its own config and secrets fields, all of them required.

IntegrationPatch.description: Merge patch. A member left out keeps its value; a config member replaces its value; a secrets member rotates that one secret. Changing any config value requires every secret of the type, so a stored secret is never sent to a new configuration. The connection check runs on the result before anything is stored.
